subject.title: fix: stop model fallback on sandbox provisioning failures

question: Does the sandbox code owner agree that failures thrown while constructing a sandbox backend must always stop model fallback, except where an explicit provider classification is already present?
rationale: This is an intentional cross-boundary retry-policy change: tests demonstrate the proposed behavior, but the sandbox owner must confirm the production taxonomy for all backend factories before it becomes the shared fallback rule.

options.title: Confirm the provisioning boundary
options.body: Approve the typed sandbox-provisioning classification and merge after current-base verification refreshes.

options.title: Narrow the boundary
options.body: Request a narrower typed conversion if any backend factory can legitimately surface a provider/model failure before provisioning completes.

recommendation.title: Confirm the provisioning boundary
recommendation.body: Approve the typed sandbox-provisioning classification and merge after current-base verification refreshes.

likelyOwner.reason: The stated CODEOWNERS entry covers the changed sandbox implementation and is the appropriate authority for its startup-error contract.
